blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Mandaue City Police Office (MCPO) will deploy around 500 police personnel to ensure public safety during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day. MCPO Director Police Colonel Cirilo Acosta Jr. said the personnel would be deployed to various cemeteries starting October 30. Police will also monitor other places of convergence, including resorts, parks, transport terminals, business establishments, and areas where people gather at night.
